title: Make shared_codex_patient_wait_outlasts_silence_budget_while_server_is_active independent of scheduling gaps
outcome: The active-server response extension test proves that liveness extends a pending request across the silence budget using controlled time and explicit phases, without relying on a helper thread being scheduled every 10 ms.
acceptance: The test deterministically arranges server activity and delivery of a response after the silence budget using an injected clock or explicit phase protocol, rather than 30 real 10 ms sleeps racing a 100 ms inactivity window.
The test still rejects a waiter that gives up at the original silence deadline despite valid intervening activity, and still checks the exact late response.
Production timeout policy is unchanged; no timeout inflation, automatic retry or ignored/quarantined test is added.
